character: Main Flaine village — 1,600m. Car-free, pedestrian-only. Modernist architecture (Marcel Breuer, 1960s). Large outdoor sculptures (Le Centaure, La Grande Main). Ski-in/ski-out. Cinema, pool, ice rink, shops. 265km Grand Massif access.
activities_nearby: Grand Massif (265km). Ice rink. Cinema. Swimming pool. Outdoor sculpture trail. Snowshoeing. Paragliding. Hiking (summer — Cirque de Flaine).
